headline: Norway Contracts 8.78M Tonnes in Moroccan Carbon Credits for 2 GW Buildout
summary: Norway agreed to buy 8.78 million tonnes of emissions credits from Morocco over ten years, providing capital to fund the North African country's 2-gigawatt renewable energy buildout.
why: Article 6 carbon credit trading under the Paris agreement offers a mechanism for sovereign states to direct clean energy investments into emerging market green grids.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Ten-year sovereign carbon payments provide dedicated revenue to fund 2 GW of new clean power capacity.
